channel.title: Gabrielle Winters Bostwick — Updates
channel.description: Updates from Gabrielle Winters Bostwick, molecular neuroscientist and comparative physiologist.

item.title: New paper! Do octopus arms follow a different set of rules?
item.description: Octopus arms can perform astonishingly complex movements. Their neurons, meanwhile, appear to have opted for open-plan seating.

item.title: Selected for the Kavli Science and Society Sparks Program
item.description: Selected for the Kavli Foundation's Science and Society Sparks Program in public engagement.

item.title: Preprint on the intramuscular nerve cords of the octopus arm
item.description: Preprint with three student co-authors on the intramuscular nerve cords of the octopus arm; in revision at the Journal of Comparative Neurology.

item.title: Kavli-Grass Fellowship at the Marine Biological Laboratory
item.description: Kavli-Grass Fellowship, Marine Biological Laboratory: calcium imaging in intact O. bimaculoides hatchling arms and a thermal challenge built on that preparation.

item.title: Invited talk at CephNeuro, Galveston
item.description: Invited talk, CephNeuro, Galveston: molecular and functional mapping of the octopus arm nervous system.
